metas.name: The 90s Club
metas.description: A charming documentary film that showcases the vibrant wisdom and life lessons from a dozen diverse individuals between 90- and 99-years-old.  “The 90s Club” hands the mic to people in their nineties to prove that empathizing with the well-aged is not just socially responsible, but hearing their voices can be inspiring, enriching, funny, and compelling. Over the course of this documentary, we meet and speak with a dozen individuals, who talk unflinchingly about death and loss, but also about love and connection, about accomplishment and meaning. Through the touching, humorous, and reflective stories and insights of the "cast" of "The 90s Club", we can all gain some perspective for our own lives as we grow older.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

metas.name: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: The Bad Guy
metas.description: The gun epidemic has become so intense in the USA, that schools and community groups are now looking away from prevention and towards preparation – tolerating mass killing as part of the fabric of American life. Measures like active shooter drills and arming teachers seem an unsavoury but necessary response to keep our loved ones safe. What impact do these militarised approaches have on children’s mental wellbeing? What kind of society will they build in the future? Told through the perspective of a European new mother, who is deciding to make a life for her young family in America, this candid and urgent documentary asks what is at stake during these frightening times.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: Uma corrida histórica pela primeira ascensão ao K2 no inverno acaba em tragédia e revela como a ambição, o ego e a sede de glória podem ser tão perigosos como a própria montanha.

metas.name: Iron Winter
metas.description: Iron Winter follows two young Mongolian horse herders who battle extreme winter cold to protect an ancient tradition that risks being lost forever. Set in the Tsakhir Valley of the Arkhangai province, one of the world's harshest human-inhabited environments, the film captures the herders' 150-day struggle to lead thousands of horses into the high country in search of edible grass hidden under the snow.

metas.name: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
metas.description: Shelley Beattie, uma mulher surda e culturista campeã, alcançou a fama na década de 1990 no programa de TV de sucesso American Gladiators, onde competiu sob o nome de "Siren" antes da sua morte prematura em 2008. Carismática, deslumbrante e uma concorrente feroz, Beattie também lutava contra demónios pessoais, enfrentando doenças mentais, vícios e questionamentos sobre a sua própria identidade. Com a perspetiva de outra mulher surda em Hollywood que também alcançou o estrelato na mesma altura, a atriz vencedora de um Óscar Marlee Matlin, o documentário desvenda a história de Shelley "Siren" Beattie e o seu complexo legado, entrelaçado com beleza, doença mental e amor.

metas.name: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
metas.description: Um futuro pai tenta perceber o que se passa com toda esta loucura da IA ​​e explora a tecnologia mais poderosa que a humanidade já criou... e o que está em causa se errarmos a mão.
